qa_pairs.question: What is the web address for the Metrix portal specifically for the Rorqual system?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal for the Rorqual system can be accessed at https://metrix.rorqual.alliancecan.ca.

qa_pairs.question: In the context of the Metrix portal, what does 'Rorqual' refer to?
qa_pairs.answer: Rorqual refers to one of the systems or clusters for which the Metrix portal provides interactive, real-time data on resource usage (CPU, GPU, memory, file system).
